title: What's new
items: Added support for FLEX archive imports and improved extraction reliability for manual backup formats.
Fixed import deduplication logic so newly created documents are no longer skipped when base PDF content is similar.
Improved folder mapping updates: document structure from documents.list now refreshes correctly on repeated imports.
Added a Recent Documents section to the sidebar with A4-style thumbnail previews, title, and date.
Made the sidebar scrollable and refined scrollbar styling to be slimmer and less visually intrusive.
Improved ink diagnostics with segment overlay tooling and refined stroke filtering behavior.
